title: Maintenance
summary: Indexes, the manifest, reindexing, and what to do when something looks wrong
intro: Read this when drag-lint gives a wrong answer, because that is almost always a stale or mis-scoped index. It explains where indexes live, how to keep them fresh and how to recognise a bad one.
